players.product: Neocloud GPU compute platform: sovereign AI factories in Australia and New Zealand running NVIDIA B300 / GB300 clusters (GPU-as-a-service, AI platform layers, high-performance storage); NVIDIA Cloud Partner

quarterly_data.signal: SharonAI 8-K (GPU-backed debt facility release; financing terms not captured): the facility supports the deployment of compute infrastructure dedicated to customer contracts and is the first in an expected series of GPU financings supporting the scheduled build out of over 68,000 NVIDIA GPUs deployed by mid-2027. CEO James Manning: demand for sovereign and secure, trusted AI infrastructure continues to outpace available supply globally, and particularly across Australia, New Zealand and the broader Asia-Pacific; the customer offtake book stands at a TCV of over US$8.8bn.
quarterly_data.figure: over 68,000 NVIDIA GPUs deployed by mid-2027
